title: Enhancing the Understanding of Abdominal Trauma During the COVID-19 Pandemic Through Co-Occurrence Analysis and Machine Learning
summary: Machine learning analyzed co-occurring findings in abdominal-trauma patients from an emergency department. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: University of Medicine and Pharmacy of Craiova

evidence.tested: Machine learning analyzed co-occurring findings in abdominal-trauma patients from an emergency department.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
